content.subject: Legacy payments and reconciliation overhead
content.draft_text:
Hi Chermaine,

I read your recent episode where you noted legacy payments aren’t built for today’s fintech world, and the point about constraints stuck with me.

When the processing layer can’t keep pace, teams spend disproportionate time untangling mismatched entries.
That pressure often surfaces as delayed settlements across regions.

We run a service that matches incoming payment data to internal ledgers, removing the manual reconciliation step.

Is the time spent on reconciling manageable for your team?

Zamp
